about: The iOS edition's screenshots (help/images/ios), cut from a CI run's artifacts by ios/tools/help_images.py. Each shot names its source: catalog:<screen>-<scene>-<device> (ios-catalog, drawn from ios/Fixtures; -light/-dark and -default are added) or shot:<device>-<name> (ios-screenshots, the running app, light only). crop is [x, y, width, height] in points; panel is a point inside a dialog's card or a sheet, which is cut out with pad points round it; callouts anchor at points of the source with an offset in output pixels, as Android's help_shots.json. scale is output pixels per point (default 720/402, Android's phone width). pad_top adds that many points of the page's colour above, for callouts over the app bar.
